# DropSpace v0.3.0-beta.27

<!-- update-summary: Beta 27 improves lyric matching for real-world metadata differences and expands NetEase search, schema, duplicate-session and playback-progress compatibility while preserving provider identity and version-conflict safeguards. -->

## Changed

- Improved lyric matching for featured/remaster title decorations, primary versus complete
  artist credits, reissue or missing album names, minor title typos and bounded duration drift.
- Kept provider candidate identity, compatible titles, version-conflict rejection, current-track
  binding, cancellation and stale-result rejection mandatory.
- Added bounded NetEase title-only recovery, legacy/current schema parsing, alias-title matching,
  empty-candidate fallback, YRC-to-LRC recovery and application-error classification.
- Improved NetEase duplicate SMTC session selection and accepted event-observed advancing
  position when a publisher leaves its valid timeline timestamp unchanged.

## Validation

See `docs/dev/beta27-lyrics-netease-audit.md` for deterministic tests, live-provider samples,
full build/test results and limitations.
